answers.core: I still believe, that godotengine/godot#45363 really is a bug. It's very irritating that masked-out button clicks are still "handled" by the control (without any real handling taking place). But if it's the intended way of how buttons work as @KoBeWi said, this should be changed in the core or *at least* be documented well.
answers.workaround: You'd have to catch clicks in _unhandled_event, check out wether it's a left mouse click, check on which control the click was carried out and then call that control's pressed function. That's basically rewriting the core functionality of the button controls.

title: Don't handle mouse clicks that are masked out
